svg.title: Beyond mise
svg.desc: Stacked area chart of cumulative GitHub stars since January 2025 for jdx's tools other than mise: 9.58k stars in total, about 1.96k a year earlier. jactionlint 360, mr boxington 821, aube 2077, fnox 2426, hk 1362, pitchfork 723, usage 1086, +5 more 725.
